## Temporal Workflow Health Overview
This dashboard provides an at-a-glance view of execution health across Customer and VLM workflows.

**Highlevels**
- Temporal Worker - Customer Workflows Insights
- Temporal Worker - VLM Workflows Insights

**These metrics don't have "project" labels as this is captured at the infrastructure level**

**What it tracks (with units)**
- Workflow and activity failures (**count**)
- Requests vs failures (**requests/min**)
- Workflow/activity latency including p99 (**seconds**)
- Long request and long request failures (**milliseconds**)
- Worker capacity: slots available/used, pollers, worker start, poller start (**count**)

time_series_query.prometheus_query:
topk(30, sum by ("location") ({"__name__"="custom.googleapis.com/temporal_num_pollers","monitored_resource"="k8s_cluster","service_instance_id"="vcp-customer-worker-service.vcp.svc.cluster.local:9090"}))
#This promql query was automatically converted from a builder query, and it may not be fully equivalent to the builder query. Manually verify the promql query before using it and edit as needed.

topk(30, histogram_quantile(0.99,sum by ("workflow_type","le")(increase({"__name__"="custom.googleapis.com/temporal_workflow_task_schedule_to_start_latency_seconds_bucket","monitored_resource"="k8s_cluster","service_instance_id"="vcp-customer-worker-service.vcp.svc.cluster.local:9090"}[${__interval}]))))
